reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with the hosted Sprites MCP service to manage persistent isolated Linux environments for remote builds, tests, experiments, and services.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Sprites MCP 服务，以管理用于构建、测试、实验和运行服务的持久隔离 Linux 环境。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the Sprites MCP service for managing persistent isolated Linux environments used for builds, tests, experiments, and long-running services.

capabilities: Connects to the hosted Sprites MCP service using OAuth
Creates and manages isolated persistent Linux environments
Runs builds, tests, experiments, and long-running services remotely
Performs filesystem changes and can create checkpoints or destroy environments
Exposes service URLs that may be internet-accessible
